title: Fix line graph x-axis showing incorrect dates

requirements.text: Fix the ProfileWinLossChart component so that the x-axis dates are derived from actual match history data rather than being generated programmatically. The chart should only display dates for which real win/loss records exist, and the date range should be anchored to the current date — not a hardcoded or stale range that can show months like August when the current month is February.

quotes: its showing dates for August and its February
I have tested around and have no availability set for that month
the chart's x-axis dates are being generated or hardcoded rather than pulled from your actual availability entries

acceptanceCriteria: The x-axis of the win/loss line chart never displays months or dates that fall outside the selected time range filter (week/month/year/all-time) relative to today's actual date.
When the 'week' filter is selected, the x-axis shows the last 7 days anchored to today.
When the 'month' filter is selected, the x-axis shows the last 30 days anchored to today.
When the 'year' filter is selected, the x-axis shows the last 12 months anchored to today.
When the 'all-time' filter is selected, the x-axis range is bounded by the earliest and latest actual match history records.
If no match history records exist for the selected range, the chart displays an appropriate empty state rather than a range of fabricated dates.
No dates from past months (e.g., August) appear on the chart when the current month is February and no data exists for August.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not change the backend data model or existing query interfaces.
nonGoals: Adding new chart types or visualizations.
Changing the time range filter options (week, month, year, all-time).
Modifying match history data storage or backend logic.
